sentences.en: And two: I want to pick the theme for TED 2006.

sentences.zh: （笑声）你有什么喜好没有？好的选择。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Good choice. (Laughter) So you can wait for the Second Coming, which is a random number between one and 500 million.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我们等着第二个出场——（笑声）它是（笑声）它是1到500万中的任意一个数字。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So really, what are we talking about here?
sentences.zh: （笑声）的确，我们在这里到底在说些什么？哦，只是一个技术玩笑。

sentences.en: Oh, tech joy. (Laughter) Tech joy, to me, means something, because I get a lot of joy out of tech.
sentences.zh: （笑声）对我来说，技术玩笑对我很重要。因为我从技术里面获得很多的快乐。

sentences.en: And in fact, making things using technology -- and I'm being serious here, even though I'm using my sarcastic voice -- I won't -- hold on.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在制作一些东西就需要使用这些技术我在这里非常认真的说，尽管我用讽刺的语气我不会——坚持住。制作东西

sentences.en: Making things, you know -- making things actually does give me a lot of joy.
sentences.zh: 制作东西真正给了我很大的乐趣。

sentences.en: It's the process of creation that keeps me sort of a bubble and a half above perpetual anxiety in my life, and it's that feeling of being about 80 percent complete on a project -- where you know you still have something to do,
sentences.zh: 这是一种创造的过程，这一过程一直让我保持着一种在我生活中恒久的焦虑。这就是我完成80%的项目的感觉但是我仍有许多事情需要去做。

sentences.en: but it's not finished, and you're not starting something -- that really fills my entire life.
sentences.zh: 因为你没有完成一件事情，你是不能开始另一件事情的。这就充满着我整个生活。

sentences.en: And so, what I've done is, I started getting interested in creating online social spaces to share that feeling with people who don't consider themselves artists.
sentences.zh: 我已经做了的是，我开始对创造网络空间感兴趣。用这样的网络空间来与大家分享感受。与那些认为自己并不是一个艺术家的人们分享感受。

sentences.en: We're in a culture of guru-ship. It's so hard to use some software because, you know, it's unapproachable, people feel like they have to read the manual.
sentences.zh: 我们正在大师舰上的文化。我们很难运用一些软件。因为它们是让人很难操作。人们会说他们不得不去阅读一下操作手册。所以呢，我也试了——

sentences.en: So I try to create these very minimal activities that allow people to express themselves, and, hopefully -- ("The End" by The Doors)
sentences.zh: （笑声）我试着创造一些微小的活动。我希望这些活动让人们学会表达自己。

sentences.en: Whoa! I'm like -- on the page, but it doesn't exist.
sentences.zh: 哦！我就在这个网页上的，但是它不存在了。（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) It's, like -- seriously, though -- (Laughter) I try to create meaningful environments for people to express themselves.
sentences.zh: 我认真的，但——（笑声）我尝试这创造一种有意义的环境。这种环境是为人们表达自己而创造的。（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) Here I created a contest called, "When Office Supplies Attack," which, I think, really resonated with the working population.
sentences.zh: 我创造一种竞赛叫做“办公用品攻击”我想这可引起一些人的共鸣（笑声）特别是工作人群的共鸣（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) Over 500 entries in three weeks.
sentences.zh: 卫生纸时尚在三周内超过了500条

sentences.en: Toilet paper fashion. (Laughter) Again, people from all over the country.
sentences.zh: （笑声）全国的人们又正

sentences.en: The watch is particularly incredible. (Laughter) Online drawing tools -- you've probably seen a lot of them.
sentences.zh: 做一种难以置信的手表。（笑声）在线画图工具——你也许曾经看到很多这类东西。

sentences.en: I think they're wonderful. It's a chance for people to get to play with crayons and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个非常奇妙。我认为这为人们蜡笔画图提供了一次很好的机会或者玩弄其他东西。我对这一过程非常感兴趣，

sentences.en: But I'm interested in the process of creating, as the real event that I'm interested in.
sentences.zh: 这种创造的过程，这才是我真正感兴趣的事。

sentences.en: And the problem is that a lot of people suck at drawing, and they get bummed out at this, sort of, you know, stick figure, awful little thing that they created.
sentences.zh: 问题就是很多人都沉浸在画图当中。他们用这样的方式来解闷。比如，画一些人物啦。以及一些他们创造的一些可怕的小东西。

sentences.en: And eventually, it just makes them stop playing with it, or they draw penises and things like that.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们还是停止画这类东西。他们画一些诸如小鸡鸡这类东西。（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) So, the Scribbler is an attempt to create a generative tool.
sentences.zh: 所以，这类三流作家尝试着创造具有生殖能力的工具。

sentences.en: In other words, it's a helping tool. You can draw your simple stick figure, and it collaborates with you to create sort of a post-war German etching.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，一种辅助工具。你也能画一些简笔画。这样的画加上你的创造，如，一种战后德国蚀刻技术。（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) In fact, it's tuned to be better at drawing things that look worse.
sentences.zh: 这你也能做的哦——事实上，你画画的技术会变得越来越好。

sentences.en: So, we go ahead, and we start scribbling.
sentences.zh: 尽管原来画得很糟糕。我们继续前进，我们开始图画，

sentences.en: So the idea is that you can really, you know, partake in this process, but watch something really crappy look beautiful.
sentences.zh: 你们也真正能加入到这一过程中来。一些东西尽管没有价值，但是看起来还挺漂亮的。

sentences.en: And here are some of my favorites. This is the little trap marionette that was submitted to me.
sentences.zh: 这里是一些我喜欢的东西。这是一个小小的困住的木偶它对我服服帖帖。非常酷吧！

sentences.en: Very cool. (Laughter) Darling. Beautiful stuff.
sentences.zh: （笑声）亲爱的，美丽的东西。

sentences.en: I mean this is incredible. An 11-year-old girl drew this and submitted it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是这简直难以置信。这是一个11岁小女孩画的上传的。这真是太美丽了。

sentences.en: It's just gorgeous. (Laughter) I'm dead serious here.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我实际上已经死了。事实上，这可不是一个笑话。

sentences.en: This is not a joke. (Laughter) But, I think it's a really fun and wonderful thing.
sentences.zh: （笑声）但我认为，这是一项非常有趣、非常美妙的东西。

sentences.en: So this is called the "Fiction Project."
sentences.zh: 所以这是称作为“幻想工程”。这是一个网络空间。

sentences.en: This is an online space, which is basically a refurbished message board that encourages collaborative fiction writing.
sentences.zh: 这是——根本上来说，这是一个刷新信息的版块。这鼓励合作写小说。这是日式的抒情小诗。

sentences.en: These are haikus. None of the haikus were written by the same person.
sentences.zh: 没有一首日式小诗是同样一个人写的，事实上，没有一行

sentences.en: In fact, each line is contributed by a different person at a different time.
sentences.zh: 每一行都是不同人写出来的。在不同的时写的。

sentences.en: I think that the "now tied up, tied down, mistress cruel approaches me, now tied down, it's up."
sentences.zh: 我想这“现在捆绑，束缚起来，”残酷小姐走向了我，现在束缚起来，她开始行动了”

sentences.en: It's an amazing way, and I'll tell you, if you come home, and your spouse, or whoever it is, says, "Let's talk" -- That, like, chills you to the very core.
sentences.zh: 我正想告诉你们，这真是令人惊奇的方式。如果你，或者你们夫妇，不管谁，能来到我的家，说，“让我来谈论吧”——这是不是让你寒战到内心底。

sentences.en: (Laughter) But it's peripheral activities like these that allow people to get together, doing fun things.
sentences.zh: 但是像这样只是周边活动而是让人们聚在一起，做一些快乐的事情。

sentences.en: They actually get to know each other, and it's sort of like low-threshold peripheral activities that I think are the key to bringing up some of our bonding social capital that we're lacking.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们想去了解对方。这只是低门槛的周边活动，但是我认为这很重要。对于培养出更多的社会资本这样的资本，我们现在正缺乏。好快呀！

sentences.en: And very, very quickly -- I love puppets.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢木偶，这个木偶！

sentences.en: Here's a puppet. It dances to music. Lotte Reiniger, an amazing shadow puppeteer in the 20s, that started doing more elaborate things.
sentences.zh: 它会随着音乐跳舞，Lotte Reiniger，在二十年代，它是一个令人惊奇的拉线木偶表演者。他开始做一些精细的东西。我开始对木偶很感兴趣了。

sentences.en: I became interested in puppets, and I just want to show one last thing to you.
sentences.zh: 我开始对木偶感兴趣 我只想给你看最后一件事

sentences.en: Oh, this is how you make puppets. (Applause) Chris Anderson: Ladies and gentlemen, Mr. Ze Frank.
sentences.zh: 我想向你们展现最后一样东西。哦，就是怎样制作木偶。（鼓掌）克里斯 安德森：女士们，先生们，泽·弗兰克！（鼓掌）

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
